full_page.content:
1939, June 10
The following is a faithful transcription of a photo copy of a handwritten message on a Seraphic. Mass Association card by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
Frank Brancaleone June 10, 1939 When the family all go to Holy Communion the child will be O.K. we hope Fr. Solanus, O.M.Cap.
Original in the possession of: Mrs. Rose McNulty 33682 Bloomfield Livonia, MI. 48154
